title: Show sources when an assistant asserts facts about records
problemCues: Assistant explains a chart point or record without showing where the claim came from
preconditions: Grounded data exists in the product
decision: Pair spoken or written claims with inspectable sources or record identifiers. Hide neither the artifact nor the citation behind the avatar.
exceptions: Purely procedural coaching with no factual claim
validatedBy: Scenario requires visible source for the selected point
